title: Silk Gland
summary: Extract three Silk Glands to make a Web Grenade ingredient.

fields.Alchemy: Extract three Silk Glands into Suspension of Spider Silk. Add any Vitriol to make a Web Grenade.
fields.Acquisition: Derryth Bonecloak or Phase Spiders, including the Matriarch.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
